input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "Hey! I've been chatting about this with friends and I'm super curious - how do airlines and ride-sharing apps actually figure out the prices they charge using dynamic pricing? I really want to know!"
Message B: "How do airlines and ride-sharing apps decide their prices using dynamic pricing?"

Which writer comes across as more **outgoing, energetic and assertive**?
(Sociable, talkative, enthusiastic and confident.)

Answer "A" or "B".
